meta.name: amazon-reviews-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users automatically extract Amazon product reviews via the Amazon Reviews API. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users express needs like getting reviews for Amazon product with ASIN B07TS6R1SF, analyzing customer feedback for a specific Amazon item, getting ratings and comments for a competitive product, tracking sentiment of recent Amazon reviews, extracting verified purchase reviews for quality assessment, summarizing user experiences from Amazon product pages, monitoring product performance through customer reviews, collecting reviewer profiles and links for market research, gathering review titles and descriptions for content analysis, scraping Amazon reviews without requiring a login.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动提取亚马逊商品评论用于分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取亚马逊商品评论做市场或质量分析
copy.tagline_en: Automatically extract Amazon product reviews for analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch fetch Amazon reviews for market or quality analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的商品 ASIN（如 B07TS6R1SF），自动提取亚马逊商品评论，包括评分、标题、正文、日期、国家、是否验证购买等信息。
howto.when: 当你需要获取某个亚马逊商品的评论、分析客户反馈、监控产品口碑或进行市场调研时，Claude 会自动调用此技能。

say.text: 帮我查一下 ASIN 是 B07TS6R1SF 的评论。
say.note: Claude 会提取该商品的评论数据。

say.text: 分析这个竞品 ASIN B08N5WRWJ6 的客户反馈。
say.note: Claude 会提取评论并可能总结。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can automatically extract Amazon product reviews based on the ASIN you provide (e.g., B07TS6R1SF), including ratings, titles, descriptions, dates, countries, and verified purchase status.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you need to get reviews for an Amazon product, analyze customer feedback, monitor product reputation, or conduct market research.

say_en.note: Claude will extract review data for that product.

say_en.text: Analyze customer feedback for competitor ASIN B08N5WRWJ6.
say_en.note: Claude will extract reviews and may summarize.
